children: Rapid Nutrition PLC launched its SystemLS AI-powered wellness app, available on Apple App Store and Google Play with free access and an optional paid Premium subscription. In eight Meta campaigns, it recorded 7,295 ad-attributed installs at approximately $2.09 per install; paid conversion and retention were not established.
Launched app with optional paid Premium subscription
Creates a potential recurring-revenue channel, but the release provides no subscription pricing or revenue.
Initial advertising acquisition benchmark only; paid conversion, retention and future performance remain unproven.
Eight Meta campaigns; approx. $15,276 ad spend
Shows the scale of the soft-launch test; no comparison with prior campaigns was provided.
App developed with US-based Portions Master
Enables the digital launch without acquiring a technology business or substantial upfront platform-development investment, according to the release.

This is an early-stage digital expansion: the app launch delivers an initiative announced on 17 November 2026, but paid demand and customer retention are not yet demonstrated. Evidence of Premium conversion, recurring revenue and repeat product purchases would be needed for the launch to become a larger catalyst.
